# Pulsarc — Open data for the Arc network

> Pulsarc is an independent analytics site for Arc, a layer-1 blockchain by
> Circle. Pulsarc is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or
> sponsored by Circle Internet Group. Site URL: https://pulsarc.vercel.app

## About this dataset

The Pulsarc indexer runs as a GitHub Action on the repository
MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer and writes JSON files to the `data` branch.
Every file is publicly readable, CORS-open, and requires no API key. GitHub's CDN caches files for about 5 minutes.

Base URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data

Files are partitioned by network. Replace <net> with `mainnet` or `testnet`:

    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/<file>

## Important: wallet counts are upper bounds

Fields named `walletHours` count distinct active wallets per hour and sum
those counts across the window. This is an upper bound (noted as ≤) on
unique wallets — a wallet active in multiple hours is counted more than once.
The files include a `note` field where this applies.

## Pages

Live pages on the Pulsarc site. No login or API key needed.

    https://pulsarc.vercel.app/map
Arc live in orbit: every new block pulses from the core, transactions fly to the tracked apps they touch, and categories orbit by 24-hour activity.

    https://pulsarc.vercel.app/defi
DeFi on Arc from DefiLlama: assets in DeFi apps, protocol fees, DEX volume, launchpad fees and stablecoin supply.

## Answer pages

Short, sourced answers read live from the files below (each page names its source file and method):
    https://pulsarc.vercel.app/answers
Questions: transaction cost, daily transactions, success rate, USDC supply, automated share of activity, USDC held by tracked apps, and (mainnet only) registered ERC-8004 agents and distinct owner wallets.
USDC held by tracked apps is the sum of USDC balances of the contracts of apps Pulsarc tracks; it is not the whole USDC supply.

## Files

### latest.json — Network snapshot
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/latest.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, windows, series
Rolling 1h / 24h / 7d windows: hours covered, blocks, transactions, failed
transactions, fees, walletHours, top, auto, account-abstraction (aa, aaTx),
buckets and mb counters, plus an hourly series of txs, failed, fees, wallets
and blocks. Updated every ~7–10 minutes.

### apps-latest.json — App activity
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/apps-latest.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, coverageHours, note, apps
Per-app transaction counts, walletHours (≤ unique wallets), volume, and fees
across 1h / 24h / 7d windows. Apps include: USDC, EURC, USYC, cirBTC, WETH,
StableFX, Memo, Multicall, CCTP, Gateway, ERC-8004, Uniswap, Across, and others.
Updated every ~7–10 minutes.

### anomalies.json — Anomaly detection
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/anomalies.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, items, status, hour
Apps whose activity in the last UTC hour moved sharply against their 24h
median. status is "ok" when the items list is empty. Updated every ~7–10 minutes.

### digest-latest.json — Digest
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/digest-latest.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, status, readyAt, hoursHeld, hoursNeeded
Precomputed digest. status is "warming-up" until 14 days (336 hours) of
indexer data have been collected. readyAt gives the estimated availability time.

### discover.json — Top contracts
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/discover.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, contracts
Top contracts by transaction count over the last 24 hours, with walletHours
(≤ unique wallets) and fees paid. Updated every ~7–10 minutes.

### agents.json — ERC-8004 agent registry
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/agents.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, registry, lastId, caughtUp, count, agents
Snapshot of the on-chain ERC-8004 identity registry: registry address, last
minted id, caughtUp flag, total count, and a list of agent records (id, owner,
uri). A limited number of ids are processed per run when caughtUp is false.

### bridge.json — CCTP bridge flows
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/bridge.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, windows, series
CCTP bridge in/out counts and USDC volume by CCTP domain across 1h / 24h / 7d
windows, plus an hourly series. Updated every ~7–10 minutes.

### supply.json — Token supply
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/supply.json
Top-level keys: generatedAt, network, tokens
Current circulating supply for USDC and EURC with an hourly series of supply,
mint, and burn amounts. Updated every ~7–10 minutes.

### state.json — Indexer state
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/state.json
Top-level keys: next, tip, network, chainId, openHour, openHourStart, skipped, updatedAt
Internal indexer state: next block to process, chain tip, network, chainId,
open hour and its start block, skipped block ranges, and the timestamp of the
last successful run.

### labels.json — Address labels
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/labels.json
Hand-maintained map from lowercase Ethereum address to a label object containing
contract flag, name, symbol, and kind. Top-level keys are addresses.

### balances.json — USDC held by tracked apps
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/balances.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, token, total, apps, series
Sum of USDC balances at the contract addresses Pulsarc tracks for each app (largest first) and an hourly series
of the total. Not every address of an app is tracked, so these are not the apps' total value.

### agents-activity.json — Agent owner activity
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/agents-activity.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, registry, totalAgents, owners, ownersMeasured, agentsMeasured, ownersWithTx, ownersWithUsdc, agentsOfOwnersWithoutTx, top
Lifetime transactions sent and USDC balance of the owner wallets of registered ERC-8004 agents. Measured on the
owner wallet, not on the agent. On testnet only the 600 owners with the most agents are measured. About hourly.

### fx.json — EURC/USDC pool rate (testnet only)
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/fx.json
Top-level keys: network, generatedAt, source, usdcPerEurc, eurcPerUsdc, change24hPct, series
Marginal price of one EURC in USDC in the Curve USDC/EURC pool, with 24h change and an hourly series. A pool
price, not an official FX rate. No verified mainnet source yet.

### feed.xml — RSS feed
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/feed.xml
RSS 2.0 feed of the apps that are moving now: hourly activity far above or below the 24h median. Updated every ~7–10 minutes.

### hourly/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json — Hourly archive
URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MertoCrypto/pulsarc-indexer/data/<net>/hourly/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json
One file per UTC day. The object is keyed by hour string in the form
"YYYY-MM-DDTHH" (e.g. "2026-10-11T00"). Each value contains the stats for
that hour.
